segments.content:
Chapter 96: This Is How Good Bros Are

Nine o'clock in the morning.

Zhao Rongjun finished packing his schoolbag at his grandpa's house. After confirming he hadn't forgotten anything, he called out to his grandpa in the living room.

"Grandpa, I'm going to a classmate's house to study. I won't be eating at home today."

"Oh!" Upon hearing this, Zhao Rongjun's grandpa quickly stood up and called into the house, "Old lady! Didn't we bring back a bunch of things from the countryside a couple of days ago? Bring some over."

A moment later, two plastic bags were stuffed into Zhao Rongjun's hands, both filled to the brim with fruits and vegetables.

"Grandpa... You don't need to give me so much. I've known Li Luo since we were kids."

"Take it all. Do you want some more?"

"This is enough, more than enough." Zhao Rongjun hurriedly slung on his schoolbag, grabbed the two large bags, and quickly slipped out the door. "I'm off then!"

Zhao Rongjun's grandpa lived not far from the First Affiliated High School, and it was only a few minutes' walk to Bihai Lanting.

When he arrived downstairs at the complex, Li Luo had already been waiting for some time. Seeing his hands full, Li Luo immediately went over to take the bags from him.

"Look at you. You could've just come empty-handed. Why bring so much stuff?"

"My grandpa insisted I take it." Zhao Rongjun said with a helpless expression. "Just take them. Eat them whenever."

"Then I won't be polite." Li Luo took one of the bags from him, then said, "You better study hard today. If you don't start trying, I'm going to surpass you in the mid-term exams."

"Isn't that a good thing?" Zhao Rongjun said. "That way, we can still get into the same university."

"Truly a good bro." Li Luo patted his shoulder in gratification. "Come on, let me give you a proper welcome."

Li Luo's words were pleasant, but when he was led upstairs and walked through the door of 1502, he saw four girls sitting in the living room and froze instantly.

"Come, come, have a seat over there. We saved a spot for you." Standing beside Zhao Rongjun, Li Luo noticed his expression, immediately shut the door, and enthusiastically pulled the half-retreating Zhao Rongjun to the desk.

"You didn't say there'd be so many people!"

Zhao Rongjun leaned close to Li Luo's ear and questioned through gritted teeth, "And why are they all girls?"

"Am I not a guy?" Li Luo retorted.

Dark lines formed on Zhao Rongjun's forehead. "...You're not even human, so what's the point of distinguishing between male and female."

"You're already here, so just sit." Li Luo pushed him down into the seat at the edge of the desk.

Resigned, Zhao Rongjun sat down with a sigh, cautiously sizing up the people at the desk from the corner of his eye.

He had a vague impression of the person sitting next to him. She seemed to be Li Luo's deskmate from Class Eight, Yan Zhusheng.

Yan Zhusheng sat in the middle of the desk by the window. On her other side was Ying Chanxi's deskmate, Qiao Xinyan.

Across from the three of them were Ying Chanxi, Li Luo, and Xu Youyu.

When he agreed to come here to study with Li Luo last night, Zhao Rongjun's thoughts were simple.

After all, the two of them hadn't seen each other during the National Day holiday, so it would be nice to visit Li Luo's place.

And he already knew Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, having eaten here with them before, so he was at least somewhat familiar with them.

But who would have thought that besides Li Luo, there would be a total of four girls here today!

This was going to be the death of him!

Facing the four girls at the table, Zhao Rongjun was immediately scared silent, unable to squeeze out a single word for a long time.

After sitting down, he silently took out his workbook and buried his head in his problems, pretending not to see anyone.

Li Luo didn't say much either, just patting his shoulder with a grin before heading to the kitchen fridge to get some ice cream pops. He gave one to everyone except Ying Chanxi.

"I thought this was an excuse to hang out under the pretense of studying," Qiao Xinyan, sitting on the other side, mumbled quietly. "Turns out we're really just here to study?"

"Let's just study hard during the day," Li Luo said with a straight face. "Of course, it's fine if you don't study. If you do a little worse on the mid-terms, at least my ranking can go up by one spot."

"Chanxi," Qiao Xinyan blinked, "why is he so arrogant?"

Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo, then kindly reminded her, "Xinyan scored 348 on the placement exam."

"Huh?" Li Luo was taken aback.

The top scorer in their Class Eight, Lu Jiahao, seemed to have only gotten 345.

Was this the strength of Class One?

Come to think of it, Zhao Rongjun also scored 330 on the placement exam.

Yan Zhusheng also scored higher than him.

So, out of the six people at the table now, he was the one with the weakest apparent strength?

"It's mainly because Qiao Xinyan usually looks a bit dopey," Li Luo shook his head and sighed. "I really didn't see the top student vibe, which made me unconsciously misjudge her."

"Don't judge a book by its cover." Qiao Xinyan took a bite of her ice cream pop. "Back in middle school, I was consistently in the top three of my grade, you know."

"My apologies for my ignorance."

After some idle chat, the six of them quickly quieted down and entered study mode.

Because Li Luo had a memory palace, memorizing knowledge points was completely effortless for him. As long as he saw it, he remembered it.

Therefore, he could focus all his study efforts on how to use these knowledge points correctly and flexibly.

Whenever he couldn't figure something out, he would directly ask Ying Chanxi or Xu Youyu.

Yan Zhusheng, on the other hand, seemed to be in her own world. She just silently put on her headphones and did her problems while listening to music.

Around ten o'clock, Li Luo stretched and decided to go cut some fruit.

Before getting up, he idly observed the others and noticed a few interesting things.

Zhao Rongjun still had his old problem. Whenever there were too many girls around, he would get nervous.

And when he was nervous, he would either bite his fingernails or tear up paper towels. If he was doing homework, it would be even more pronounced.

Yan Zhusheng was much more ordinary. She simply liked listening to music and would occasionally hum a few lines unconsciously.

But the moment she realized there were other people around, she would immediately stop.

Li Luo highly suspected that when this girl did her homework alone at home, she would probably start singing as she worked.

Qiao Xinyan liked to spin her pen. Xu Youyu liked to rest one leg under her bottom, then switch to the other after a while.

Ying Chanxi was the most normal one, with no strange quirks. Her posture was perfectly upright, though she was a bit obsessive-compulsive, always needing her textbooks and workbooks arranged neatly and having to adjust them every so often.

Li Luo smiled, got up, and went into the kitchen. He took out some of the fruit Zhao Rongjun had brought, washed it in the sink, then cut it up, arranged it on several plates, and brought them to the desk in the living room.

"Help yourselves. Zhao Rongjun brought all of this," Li Luo said, sitting back down in his seat.

But Yan Zhusheng, across from him, was engrossed in her work with her headphones on and apparently didn't hear him.

So Li Luo reached out and tapped his fingers on the desk in front of her.

Seeing Li Luo's gesture, Yan Zhusheng looked up at him blankly, then blinked, seeming to understand what he meant. She took off one of her earbuds and offered it to him.

Li Luo: "...I was telling you to eat fruit, not asking to listen to music."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng finally realized, took back her earbud, and picked up a slice of watermelon to enjoy.

But beside Li Luo, Ying Chanxi glanced over and asked with a curious look, "Do you often ask Yan Zhusheng for her earbud to listen to music?"

"Just occasionally." Li Luo coughed twice. "Wasn't I asking her to record a song before? That one, 'Waiting For You After Class,' so I used her phone to listen to it back then."

Ying Chanxi withdrew her gaze. "You don't have to explain so clearly. Get me a piece of cantaloupe."

"Here." Li Luo picked up a toothpick, speared a piece for Ying Chanxi, and handed it to her.

Ying Chanxi didn't take it with her hand, simply opening her mouth to bite it, then turning to Zhao Rongjun with a calm expression. "It's very sweet. Zhao Rongjun, where did you buy this?"

"My grandma brought it back from the countryside. A relative grew it," Zhao Rongjun replied in a low voice.

"Oh, no wonder." Ying Chanxi nodded, picked up a grape from the plate in front of her, and popped it into Li Luo's mouth. Then she passed another to Xu Youyu at the other end. "Senior, you try some too."

"Thanks." Xu Youyu, completely oblivious to the situation at the table, simply took the grape from Ying Chanxi and put it in her mouth, then continued scribbling on her scratchpad, immersed in the world of her outline, while also switching which leg was tucked under her.

The movement was too big, and her pale foot kicked Li Luo squarely in the thigh.

"Uh... sorry, sorry, hahaha." Xu Youyu pulled her foot back and even thoughtfully patted Li Luo's thigh. "You okay?"

"You don't sit like this at school, do you?" Li Luo glanced at Xu Youyu's posture and couldn't help asking.

"Of course not," Xu Youyu said. "I have to maintain my image at school. At home, I can relax, of course."

As she spoke, Xu Youyu decisively pulled her other leg up too, sitting cross-legged on the chair, propping her hands on her ankles, and rocking back and forth happily.

The group continued to study while eating fruit.

At eleven in the morning, Ying Chanxi called out to Xu Youyu and Qiao Xinyan, getting ready to go downstairs to buy groceries. She also asked Yan Zhusheng, "Zhusheng, want to come grocery shopping with us?"

Yan Zhusheng shook her head and pointed to the piano room next to them. "I want to play the piano for a bit."

"OK." Ying Chanxi nodded. "Then what do you want to eat? We'll go buy the ingredients."

Yan Zhusheng blinked, then looked at Li Luo.

"Just remember to buy a swamp eel and some chicken drumsticks," Li Luo said while clearing the plates from the desk.

"Oh." Ying Chanxi looked at Yan Zhusheng, then back at Li Luo. "We're heading out then."

Watching Ying Chanxi and the other two leave, and with Yan Zhusheng disappearing into the piano room, Zhao Rongjun's tense body finally relaxed.

The next second, he irritably pushed Li Luo down onto the sofa. "Is this how you treat your good bro?"

"What's not good about this?" Li Luo pushed him away with a smile. "Four beautiful girls keeping you company while you do homework. Go ask any guy at school. If word of this gets out, they'd all pay to line up for this, okay."

"So I should thank you then?" Zhao Rongjun rolled his eyes.

"Alright, alright." Li Luo waved his hand and pushed Zhao Rongjun towards his bedroom. "Go play on the computer for a while. The password is 0314. I'll call you when lunch is ready."

After getting Zhao Rongjun settled, Li Luo stretched and then walked into the piano room.

(End of Chapter)
